_provenance: Generated 2026-09-04 from the published catalog (buena-mono.buenalabs.io/graphs.md); regenerate rather than hand-edit.

graph-frame.title: Frame
graph-frame.description: Not a graph — the dashed figure the other twenty-nine are drawn inside. Compose it with GraphBody, GraphTitle, GraphRule, GraphTrack and GraphTick to draw one of your own.

graph-activity.title: Activity
graph-activity.description: A contribution grid. Dated counts in, weeks and intensity derived.

graph-calendar.title: Calendar
graph-calendar.description: One month on a seven-column grid, with days marked and one picked out.

graph-uptime.title: Uptime
graph-uptime.description: A status strip — one cell a day, three states and a gap.

graph-cells.title: Cells
graph-cells.description: Small multiples of an on-and-off grid — the same shape drawn once per group, for comparing patterns rather than magnitudes.

graph-waffle.title: Waffle
graph-waffle.description: A percentage as a block of cells, when a bar would not show the remainder.

graph-spark.title: Spark
graph-spark.description: A sparkline in block glyphs, scaled to its own highest point.

graph-plot.title: Plot
graph-plot.description: A line or area plot with a y-scale, for when the magnitude matters.

graph-kpi.title: KPI
graph-kpi.description: One number with its trend under it — a headline that shows its working.

graph-heatmap.title: Heatmap
graph-heatmap.description: A punchcard: labelled rows against labelled columns, intensity by glyph.

graph-slope.title: Slope
graph-slope.description: Two columns and the lines between them — what moved, and which way.

graph-bars.title: Bars
graph-bars.description: Two series above and below a label — a before and after of the same categories, with the thing between them named.

graph-rank.title: Rank
graph-rank.description: An ordered bar list — the shape you want for a top-n.

graph-meter.title: Meter
graph-meter.description: A single value on a track — the smallest chart that is still a chart.

graph-bullet.title: Bullet
graph-bullet.description: Value against target on one track, for a number with something to beat.

graph-stack.title: Stack
graph-stack.description: Parts of a whole, one row per group. The palette that earns three hues.

graph-funnel.title: Funnel
graph-funnel.description: Steps that only ever narrow, with the drop shown at each one.

graph-waterfall.title: Waterfall
graph-waterfall.description: How a total was arrived at — a start, the moves, and where it landed.

graph-tree.title: Tree
graph-tree.description: A hierarchy in branch glyphs, with one node carrying the accent.

graph-flow.title: Flow
graph-flow.description: Nodes on dashed arrows. Rows read left to right; one path can be accented.

graph-timeline.title: Timeline
graph-timeline.description: Dated events down a connector, with done, current and upcoming states.

graph-gantt.title: Gantt
graph-gantt.description: Bars on a shared track, measured from day counts rather than drawn.

graph-table.title: Table
graph-table.description: A plain table inside the frame, with per-column alignment and a footer.

graph-compare.title: Compare
graph-compare.description: A feature matrix. Booleans draw as ✓ and –; one column takes the accent.

graph-spec.title: Spec
graph-spec.description: A definition list — labels down the left, values right, one accented.

graph-stat.title: Stat
graph-stat.description: A row of headline figures, each with a label and an optional hint.

graph-diff.title: Diff
graph-diff.description: Added, removed and unchanged rows, with a total at the bottom.

graph-invoice.title: Invoice
graph-invoice.description: A document rather than a chart — the frame doing receipts and statements.

graph-timer.title: Timer
graph-timer.description: Elapsed time, time since, or a wall clock.

graph-countdown.title: Countdown
graph-countdown.description: Time remaining until an instant, with a message for when it lands.
